The first Formula 1 World Championship race took place at Silverstone in 1950.
A modern F1 pit stop can be completed in under 2.5 seconds.
Monaco has one of the shortest laps on the calendar, at roughly 3.3 km.
Lewis Hamilton and Michael Schumacher share the record of seven drivers' world titles.
In fast corners, F1 drivers can experience lateral forces of around 5 g.
Drivers can lose up to around 3 kg of body weight during a hot race.
The 25-18-15-12-10-8-6-4-2-1 points system has been used since 2010.
Monza is nicknamed the 'Temple of Speed' for its long, flat-out straights.
